playn-go-fangs-and-fire.editorial: Fangs & Fire builds four bonus scenarios around one Gong system, but Prowler and Serpent change it differently: the former keeps 5×3 re-spins, the latter opens 5×7, and the joint trigger turns grid filling into gradual row unlocking.

features.title: Golden Gongs
features.description: Link’n GO Golden Gongs activate when two or more Gongs form a continuous horizontal line: each Gong reveals a number or arrow, and neighbouring Gongs combine their values and immediately pay a reward.

features.title: Prowler and Serpent
features.description: If at least one Gong is present but the feature has not triggered, a Celestial Gong can randomly add another 3–10 Gongs.

features.title: Joint Guardians bonus
features.description: Three Prowler Scatters trigger 3 re-spins on a 5×3 grid, with the counter resetting on a new Gong. Three Serpent Scatters expand the grid to 5×7. Any five Scatters including both guardians open Serpent & Prowler Bonus: 3 re-spins start, rows open as new Gongs arrive, and filling 34 Gongs triggers the Mythical Prize.

intro: Hot Slot: 777 Hold the Jackpot combines ten lines with a standalone Hold the Jackpot, where Bonus symbols carry prize values.
Cash Infinity locks red symbols on the grid to help reach the bonus, while Chance Level offers a higher trigger probability for a larger bet.
wazdan-hot-slot-777-hold-the-jackpot.editorial: The Grand Jackpot worth 1500x refers to completion of the jackpot scenario rather than any seven combination. This is not the Coin Bonus from 777 Coins.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot
features.description: The bonus mode accumulates money values and separate jackpot symbols, including Grand 1500x.

features.title: Cash Infinity
features.description: Retained red symbols stay under Cash Infinity rules and help bring the bonus closer.

features.title: Chance Level and Buy Feature
features.description: Bonus chances can be increased through Chance Level; the official list also includes a separate bonus-feature purchase.

intro: RotoGrid charges with 1–4 rotations of 90° and rotates the entire grid sequentially after the original drop is calculated. Each turn can form new paylines.

During rotation, Oozing Beakers break, and Ooze flows downwards, turning covered positions into Wilds. Blue Ooze carries adding multipliers, Pink carries multiplying ones; overlapping values combine, and mixed Green Ooze becomes multiplying.
hacksaw-gaming-twisted-lab.editorial: Twisted Lab connects grid rotation with the physical ‘flow’ of multipliers down the reels: RotoGrid changes payline geometry, while Beakers simultaneously create Wild zones and accumulate Ooze values on the same positions.

features.title: RotoGrid and Oozing Beakers
features.description: RotoGrid turns the grid through 90°, Beakers pour Wild Ooze downwards, and overlapping Blue/Pink values combine into stronger reel multipliers.

features.title: Unleash the Ooze!
features.description: Three FS Scatters award ten Unleash the Ooze! Free Spins. RotoGrid, FS Symbols and Oozing Beakers appear more frequently during the bonus, allowing Wild positions and new multipliers after rotations.

features.title: Twist of the Twisted
features.description: In a separate mode, Twisters and Collectors remain on the grid: rotating the grid changes the active side of a Twister. Three replenishing lives are extended by new Twisters or Collector Symbols.

intro: Play’n GO describes four separate bonus features. In Burger Bonanza, landed Burgers stay sticky and award a re-spin; the sequence continues while new Burgers keep appearing, after which the collected prize value pays.

Flip the Tip starts with three coins and increases the multiplier for successful throws into a tip jar; Greasy Wilds turns 1 to 5 reels into Wild reels. Five Star Free Spins uses a Five Star symbol: each such symbol increases the Win Multiplier and adds 2 spins, while the multiplier grows from x2 to x6.
playn-go-fat-frankies.editorial: Fat Frankies does not reduce everything to one bonus structure: its four modes use entirely different actions—sticky Burgers, risk with tip coins, a random number of Wild reels and progressive Free Spins. The provider's public description does not detail the exact entry conditions for each Bonus Round, so Slotfolio does not invent them.

features.title: Burger Bonanza
features.description: Play’n GO describes four separate bonus features.

features.title: Flip the Tip and Greasy Wilds
features.description: In Burger Bonanza, landed Burgers stay sticky and award a re-spin; the sequence continues while new Burgers keep appearing, after which the collected prize value pays.

features.title: Five Star Free Spins
features.description: Flip the Tip starts with three coins and increases the multiplier for successful throws into a tip jar; Greasy Wilds turns 1 to 5 reels into Wild reels. Five Star Free Spins uses a Five Star symbol: each such symbol increases the Win Multiplier and adds 2 spins, while the multiplier grows from x2 to x6.

intro: Platinum Crown retains five reels and ten lines but makes the Grand Jackpot worth 2500x its main target. It can be reached in two ways.
Five crown Scatters open Grand, as do fifteen sevens across the whole grid; two, three or four crowns award lower prize tiers.
wazdan-hot-slot-777-platinum-crown.editorial: Platinum Crown differs from Gold's 1500x and Diamond's 5000x in more than logo colour. Its reference RTP of 96.17% and medium volatility are separately confirmed.

features.title: Two routes to 2500x
features.description: Grand can be awarded for five crown Scatters or all fifteen positions filled with sevens.

features.title: Scatter ladder
features.description: Two, three, four and five Scatters award successive prizes on a separate scale.

features.title: Chance Level and Volatility Levels
features.description: Three Chance Level options change bet cost and jackpot probability; Volatility Levels is separately listed in the technical record.

intro: A Liberty Gem acts as a Wild Multiplier and triggers a Freedom Respin, remaining Sticky. Every new Gem extends the sequence, while the multipliers of multiple Gems in one win add together.
Four or more Liberty Gems in a 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 or 5x5 square form a Gem Cluster. A Classic Cluster adds Gem values, while an Epic Cluster additionally multiplies their sum by a separate multiplier.
hacksaw-gaming-ultimate-slot-of-america.editorial: Ultimate Slot of America turns Sticky Gems into spatial progression: collecting many is not enough—forming an exact square is beneficial. An Epic Cluster adds a second multiplier layer above the Gem values already summed.

features.title: Freedom Respins and Gem Clusters
features.description: Liberty Gems award Sticky respins, square groups merge into a Classic or Epic Cluster, and the Epic version additionally multiplies the combined Gem multiplier.

features.title: Spin-dependence Day
features.description: Three FS trigger ten Spin-dependence Day spins with an increased chance of Liberty Gems. Each new Gem in the base mechanic can continue a Freedom Respins sequence.

features.title: Red, White, Bling and Pursuit of Riches
features.description: Four FS award Red, White, Bling with Sticky Gems and Clusters but without Freedom Respins; five FS open Pursuit of Riches with at least five Liberty Gems on every spin.

intro: Blitzways Dynamic Reels change each reel's height from 2 to 7 symbols and provide up to 16,807 ways to win. Wins form as clusters connecting matching symbols across three or more adjacent reels; after paying, winning symbols disappear and start a cascade.

Wilds are created after wins. If the next win uses a Wild, its replacement becomes a Multiplier Wild, allowing subsequent clusters to be enhanced. Three Scatters trigger Free Spins: one Wild appears at a random position and stays sticky for the whole round, while each additional Scatter adds another spin.
playn-go-fate-of-dead-blitzways.editorial: Fate of Dead Blitzways does not carry over the classic Expanding Symbol from older Dead games. Its central mechanics are dynamic reel height, cluster cascades and Wild → Multiplier Wild evolution, while Free Spins lock one starting Wild.

features.title: Blitzways Dynamic Reels
features.description: Blitzways Dynamic Reels change each reel's height from 2 to 7 symbols and provide up to 16,807 ways to win.

features.title: Cluster Cascades
features.description: Wins form as clusters connecting matching symbols across three or more adjacent reels; after paying, winning symbols disappear and start a cascade.

features.title: Sticky Free Spins
features.description: If the next win uses a Wild, its replacement becomes a Multiplier Wild, allowing subsequent clusters to be enhanced. Three Scatters trigger Free Spins: one Wild appears at a random position and stays sticky for the whole round, while each additional Scatter adds another spin.

intro: 777 Rubies replaces bonus coins with rubies: collecting five rubies opens the Grand Jackpot worth 500x, while smaller sets correspond to lower prizes.
Magic Respin helps hold reels for a jackpot combination. This is not 9 Coins Jackpot, although base payouts still run across twenty lines.
wazdan-hot-slot-777-rubies.editorial: Rubies has a maximum of 500x, Low/Standard/High volatility settings and a separate Magic Respin. The lighter version's mathematics should not be carried over automatically.

features.title: Five rubies
features.description: Five Ruby symbols open the Grand Jackpot worth 500x the bet.

features.title: Magic Respin
features.description: Allows reels to lock and attempts to collect bonus rubies to continue.

features.title: Volatility Levels
features.description: Three profiles are officially listed: low, standard and high. Gamble is a separate post-payout risk game.

intro: A Lightning Bolt activates the Multiplier Light on its row. When a win appears on an active row, its multiplier increases by +1 for every winning symbol and applies to the payout.

Multiplier Boost doubles a particular row's multiplier, Epic Boost doubles every row's multiplier, and Blackout Skull disables a row until the next Lightning Bolt. For a win through multiple active rows, their multipliers add together.
hacksaw-gaming-vending-machine.editorial: Vending Machine turns each horizontal row into a separate growing multiplier. The key is both activating Multiplier Lights and keeping them active while Boosts and repeated wins increase their values.

features.title: Multiplier Lights and Boosts
features.description: Lightning activates a row multiplier, wins increase it, Boosts double one or all rows, and Blackout temporarily disables the corresponding Light.

features.title: Remove & Cascade
features.description: If no win forms after the reels stop, an additional Remove & Cascade can activate: all low-paying symbols are removed and new ones land in their places.

features.title: Lo-Fi Spins and Spin & Chill
features.description: Three FS trigger Lo-Fi Spins with three active Multiplier Light rows; four FS open Spin & Chill, where all five rows are lit from the start. Both bonuses end when their lights are disabled.

intro: Every Ulysses symbol in the base game fills a shield counter. On the 20th spin, collected symbols turn into arrows for Barrage Bonus: arrows strike random positions and can make them Wild or Expanding Wild.

Poseidon’s Wrath collects Scatters that did not trigger a feature themselves and can activate the Wheel. Three Scatters trigger the Wheel from Level One, four start a stage higher, and five immediately open Mythical Free Spins. In regular Free Spins, Barrage activates on spins where the shield counter holds a value; Mythical mode can additionally create Sticky Expanding Wilds.
playn-go-fates-fortune.editorial: Fate’s Fortune connects a long-term shield counter with Barrage Bonus and separately develops Poseidon’s Wrath through Scatters. Five Scatters skip regular Wheel progression and go straight to Mythical Free Spins, where the available Wild transformations become stronger.

features.description: Every Ulysses symbol in the base game fills a shield counter.

intro: 777 Rubies Extremely Light brings Magic Respin and 5 Rubies Jackpot into a lighter presentation. Loading and energy use are reduced, while twenty lines remain.
The Grand Jackpot is still tied to five rubies; this version's official technical record separately lists high volatility.
wazdan-hot-slot-777-rubies-extremely-lig.editorial: The lighter version has the same upper payout of 500x and RTP of 96.14%, but its listed High volatility category should not automatically replace the original adjustable levels of regular Rubies.

features.title: Magic Respin
features.description: The reel-holding mode helps bring the ruby count to the bonus threshold.

features.title: 5 Rubies Jackpot
features.description: Five Ruby symbols open the Grand Jackpot worth 500x; lower jackpots remain separate prizes.

features.title: Extremely Light
features.description: Effects are optimised for faster loading and lower battery and mobile data use.

intro: An Orb of the Moon selects one random symbol type and replaces all its instances, including itself, with a higher-paying symbol or Wild. An Orb of the Sun does the same for two types at once.

If low-paying symbols spell HORUS horizontally, the game pays a fixed cash prize. During bonuses, a separate Orb progression bar accumulates levels through new wins and determines the number of guaranteed Orbs before the final drop.
hacksaw-gaming-wings-of-horus.editorial: Wings of Horus uses mass replacement of matching symbols as its main way of reshaping the grid. During the bonus, every new win also charges the final Orb drop, so early combinations directly strengthen the mode's final spin.

features.title: Orbs and progression bar
features.description: The Moon Orb replaces one symbol type, the Sun Orb two, while the bonus meter accumulates levels and turns them into additional Orbs before the final drop.

features.title: Sacred Scripture: HORUS
features.description: When low-paying symbols spell HORUS horizontally on the grid, a separate fixed payout of 500x the current bet triggers. This is not the overall maximum win.

features.title: Revenge of the Pharaoh and Rise of the Falcon
features.description: Three FS award ten Revenge spins with the Orb Meter starting at the first level; four FS trigger Rise of the Falcon with the same progression but an initial second level.

intro: Feline Wilds activate randomly in the base game and turn one or more cat symbols into Wilds for the current spin. Fury Reels can activate at the same time: 1 to 5 reels are designated Fury, and a Feline Wild on such a reel expands across it; two Feline Wilds award x2, three award x3.

Three Holy Grail of Cat Food Scatters trigger 5 Free Spins. Shields collect during the bonus: every 12 shields turn the corresponding cat symbol into a Feline Wild for the rest of the round and add another 3 spins. An additional Scatter adds one more spin.
playn-go-feline-fury.editorial: Feline Fury makes cats progressive Wilds: in the base game their strength is random and short-lived, while shield collection during Free Spins fixes a particular cat as a Wild until the round ends. A Fury Reel can then turn that Wild into a full-reel multiplier event.

features.title: Feline Wilds
features.description: Feline Wilds activate randomly in the base game and turn one or more cat symbols into Wilds for the current spin.

features.title: Fury Reels
features.description: Fury Reels can activate at the same time: 1 to 5 reels are designated Fury, and a Feline Wild on such a reel expands across it; two Feline Wilds award x2, three award x3.

features.title: Shield Free Spins
features.description: Three Holy Grail of Cat Food Scatters trigger 5 Free Spins. Shields collect during the bonus: every 12 shields turn the corresponding cat symbol into a Feline Wild for the rest of the round and add another 3 spins. An additional Scatter adds one more spin.

intro: Hot Slot: 777 Stars is built around red star Scatters and the 9 Stars Jackpot system. Bonus prize tiers require star combinations rather than Coins or Rubies.
Five reels with twenty lines and fruit symbols retain a classic foundation; the provider lists no separate Free Spins.
wazdan-hot-slot-777-stars.editorial: The star Scatter handles direct jackpot payouts here. The maximum of 500x should not be interpreted as an award for any landed Scatter.

features.title: 9 Stars Jackpot
features.description: Star Scatters form separate winning jackpot combinations; they should not be confused with 9 Coins Jackpot thresholds.

features.title: Red star Scatter
features.description: The special symbol awards a prize under the bonus table rather than necessarily starting a spin sequence.

features.title: Gamble and Volatility Levels
features.description: A separate risk option follows a win, and Wazdan publishes adjustable volatility levels.

intro: A Genie symbol appears on reels 2–6 and blows Clouds leftwards along its entire row to the grid's edge.
All positions occupied by the Genie or Clouds count as Wild symbols. FS remain active even beneath Wild Clouds if they participate in a win.
hacksaw-gaming-wishbringer.editorial: Wishbringer uses simple but directional geometry: one Genie turns the entire row section to its left into a Wild Cloud Row. Its value therefore directly depends on how far to the right it lands.

features.title: Wild Cloud Rows
features.description: A Genie blows Wild Clouds leftwards along a row, turning covered positions into Wilds; bonuses increase the frequency of guaranteed Genie symbols.

features.title: Arabian Nights Free Spins
features.description: Three, four, five and six FS Scatters trigger 5, 10, 20 and 40 Arabian Nights spins respectively. Two additional FS during the bonus award another two spins, while three award four.

features.title: Genie FeatureSpins
features.description: Where permitted, Genie’s Wish FeatureSpins guarantees at least one Genie on reels 2–6, while Genie’s Magic guarantees a Genie on reels 4–6. These are paid options rather than base rules.

intro: Re-Spin of Fire triggers if two reels are completely filled with the same stacked symbol but no win forms: those stacks lock, and the third reel receives a re-spin. If two possible pairs qualify, the game holds the pair with the higher-paying symbol.
If all three reels are completely filled with the same symbol, the Wheel of Fire triggers. The wheel applies a multiplier to the win; in Fire Joker 100, the Wheel's official maximum reaches x100.
playn-go-fire-joker-100.editorial: Fire Joker 100 deliberately retains the original's three-reel simplicity but raises the Wheel ceiling and clarifies stacked-pair selection for a re-spin. It has no Coin Collect or Ice mechanics from other Fire Joker games.

features.title: Re-Spin of Fire
features.description: Re-Spin of Fire triggers if two reels are completely filled with the same stacked symbol but no win forms: those stacks lock, and the third reel receives a re-spin.

features.title: Selecting a stacked pair
features.description: If two possible pairs qualify, the game holds the pair with the higher-paying symbol.

features.title: Wheel of Fire
features.description: If all three reels are completely filled with the same symbol, the Wheel of Fire triggers. The wheel applies a multiplier to the win; in Fire Joker 100, the Wheel's official maximum reaches x100.

intro: 777 Stars Extremely Light retains Stars' five-reel structure and 9 Stars Jackpot system but reduces graphics and energy requirements.
Star Scatters award prizes under a separate jackpot table. This is not a reissue of 777 Rubies or a Hold the Jackpot mode.
wazdan-hot-slot-777-stars-extremely-ligh.editorial: Comparing Stars with Stars Extremely Light shows identical RTP of 96.10% and 500x. The documented difference is loading optimisation rather than a new bonus.

features.title: 9 Stars Jackpot
features.description: Star Scatter combinations open prize tiers without needing a Cash Out collector.

features.title: Fast, lighter version
features.description: Simplified graphics and animations save data and device charge.

features.title: 20 lines and Gamble
features.description: Base wins pay across twenty lines, while the risk game is available only separately after a win.

intro: A Wild Santa expands downwards if the expansion participates in a winning combination. All covered positions become Wild, while a Santa that does not expand remains a single Wild.

If an expanding Santa passes through a Wild Gift, the Gift becomes a multiplier from x2 to x200. If multiple expanded Santas with multipliers participate in one combination, their values add together.
hacksaw-gaming-xmas-drop.editorial: Xmas Drop builds its mechanic around Santa's vertical path: crossing more useful symbols during expansion can strengthen the resulting reel multiplier. In the higher bonus, activated reels then guarantee a Santa until the free spins end.

features.title: Wild Santa and Wild Gifts
features.description: Santa expands downwards into a Wild reel, Gifts become multipliers when crossed, and multiple Santa multipliers in one win add together.

features.title: Night Before Christmas
features.description: Three FS Scatters trigger ten Night Before Christmas spins with an increased chance of Wild Santa and Wild Gift. Four FS during this bonus move the game into the higher Santa mode.

features.title: Santa Claus Is Coming To Town
features.description: Four FS trigger ten Santa Claus Is Coming To Town spins. A reel on which Wild Santa lands activates and guarantees a new Santa until the bonus ends.

intro: Coin Scatters carry multiplier values, and a Pig Collect symbol collects them when landing together. Two Collect symbols without Coin Scatters trigger Re-Spin Chance. Coins can also visually collect in the Golden Joker above the reels, but Play’n GO explicitly describes this as a perceived persistent state rather than a hidden meter with a guaranteed payout.

Fire Blitz Mode guarantees a Fire Joker Collector on every spin, and only this mode can produce a rare gold symbol with an x150 payout. Free Spins use a progression meter tied to Feature Scatters: new stages open stronger multipliers and additional spins.
playn-go-fire-joker-blitz.editorial: Fire Joker Blitz moves far beyond classic stacked-reel Fire Joker: its main cycle involves Coin Collect, Collector symbols and stage-based Free Spins. The Golden Joker should not be treated as a real accumulating jackpot: the provider explicitly calls it a visual perceived persistent state.

features.title: Coin Collection
features.description: Coin Scatters carry multiplier values, and a Pig Collect symbol collects them when landing together.

features.title: Re-Spin Chance
features.description: Two Collect symbols without Coin Scatters trigger Re-Spin Chance.

features.title: Fire Blitz and Free Spins
features.description: Coins can also visually collect in the Golden Joker above the reels, but Play’n GO explicitly describes this as a perceived persistent state rather than a hidden meter with a guaranteed payout. Fire Blitz Mode guarantees a Fire Joker Collector on every spin, and only this mode can produce a rare gold symbol with an x150 payout. Free Spins use a progression meter tied to Feature Scatters: new stages open stronger multipliers and additional spins.

intro: Diamond Coins combines fifteen independent positions with two Hot Slot lines and Hold the Jackpot. Outside the bonus, additional Hot Slot symbols provide regular payouts.
Red Cash Infinity symbols can lock on the grid and help activate the bonus mode. The Grand Jackpot here is 3000x rather than Gold Coins' 750x.
wazdan-hot-slot-diamond-coins.editorial: The two lines in Diamond Coins' technical record belong to the base Hot Slot symbols; a prize-accumulation system operates separately. These two payout types should not be mixed.

features.title: Cash Infinity
features.description: Red positions persist, increasing the chance of accumulating symbols for Hold the Jackpot.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot with Grand 3000x
features.description: Money and jackpot values collect in the bonus; the overall stated maximum is 3000x.

features.title: Two additional Hot Slot lines
features.description: Special symbols on two lines add base payouts without changing the held bonus conditions.

intro: Super Cascades remove all regular symbols of the winning type, and the positions beneath winning symbols become Divine Squares.

After wins finish, Hand of Zeus activates Divine Squares: they reveal Coins, Zap of Zeus or Vessel of Wealth. Zaps multiply neighbouring cash values, while Vessels sequentially collect Coins and values from previous Vessels.
hacksaw-gaming-ze-zeus.editorial: Ze Zeus turns cascades into preparation for a money phase: wins first mark Divine Squares, and Hand of Zeus later starts a chain of reveals, multiplication and sequential value collection.

features.title: Divine Squares, Zaps and Vessels
features.description: Super Cascades create Divine Squares, Hand of Zeus activates them, Zaps enhance neighbouring values, and Vessels collect cash prizes in a chain.

features.title: What if Zeus Was One of Us?
features.description: Three FS trigger a bonus in which Divine Squares persist between spins until Hand of Zeus activates them. Four FS can upgrade this mode to Ze Zeus Take the Wheel.

features.title: Take the Wheel and Might Superstar
features.description: With four FS, Divine Squares remain even after Hand of Zeus activates; five FS open Might Superstar with mandatory Hand of Zeus on every spin and no Bronze Coins.

intro: An Ice Joker on a losing spin triggers Re-Spins of Ice: the Joker locks, becomes a full-reel stack, and the other reels spin again. Re-Spins of Fire work differently—they trigger when two reels are already filled with matching stacked symbols.

A full screen of one symbol, including Fire/Ice Joker Wilds, triggers the Wheel of Fire and Ice. The wheel uses four sequential effects with Ice additions and multipliers; the strongest fourth version contains x6, x10 and x20.
playn-go-fire-joker-freeze.editorial: Fire Joker Freeze deliberately contrasts two opposing mechanics: Ice creates a stacked reel after a non-winning spin, while Fire locks matching stacks already present. The Wheel joins the two paths only when the whole screen becomes one symbol.

features.title: Re-Spins of Ice
features.description: An Ice Joker on a losing spin triggers Re-Spins of Ice: the Joker locks, becomes a full-reel stack, and the other reels spin again.

features.title: Re-Spins of Fire
features.description: Re-Spins of Fire work differently—they trigger when two reels are already filled with matching stacked symbols.

features.title: Wheel of Fire and Ice
features.description: A full screen of one symbol, including Fire/Ice Joker Wilds, triggers the Wheel of Fire and Ice. The wheel uses four sequential effects with Ice additions and multipliers; the strongest fourth version contains x6, x10 and x20.

intro: Gold Coins combines fifteen Coin positions with ten Hot Slot lines. Cash Infinity helps approach Hold the Jackpot, while classic symbols handle regular wins.
This gold version's Grand Jackpot is 750x. That is substantially below Platinum Coins' 2500x and Diamond Coins' 3000x.
wazdan-hot-slot-gold-coins.editorial: Gold Coins has two important independent parts: retro base-game lines and held Cash Infinity symbols on the route to the bonus. The stated maximum win of 750x applies to the whole game.

features.title: Cash Infinity
features.description: Locks special red symbols, preparing the grid to trigger Hold the Jackpot.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot with Grand 750x
features.description: Collects prize values during the bonus; the gold version's top award is 750x the bet.

features.title: Hot Slot symbols and Chance Level
features.description: Retro symbols support frequent base payouts, while Chance Level increases bonus-trigger probability at a higher bet cost.

intro: Wonder symbols land vertically on reels 2–5 and reveal high-paying symbols, Wilds or entire Wonder Reels. A win after the reveal triggers sticky respins until new wins stop or a Wonder Reel appears.
Wonder Reels reveal Coins, Diamonds, Clovers and Pots of Olympus. Coins and Diamonds award cash prizes, Clovers multiply them, and Pots collect all values into one total.
hacksaw-gaming-zeus-ze-zecond.editorial: Zeus Ze Zecond connects a Mystery-style reveal with sticky respins: regular Wonder symbols sustain the winning chain, while a Wonder Reel moves the round into a separate cash phase. Godly Ascension adds a progressive Wonder Meter.

features.title: Wonder Symbols and Wonder Reels
features.description: Wonder symbols reveal paying/Wild symbols or a whole Wonder Reel, a win triggers sticky respins, and Wonder Reels collect cash values through Coins, Clovers and Pots.

features.title: Gates of Hades
features.description: In Gates of Hades, all landed Wonder Symbols become Sticky and stay at their positions until the bonus sequence ends, retaining the base game's Wonder Reveal mechanic.

features.title: Godly Ascension and Zeus Unleashed
features.description: Godly Ascension accumulates the Wonder Meter and triggers prize spins with a full grid of Wonder Symbols; Zeus Unleashed immediately fills reels 2–5 with Wonder Symbols and excludes low-paying symbols.

intro: The Firefly Scatter also acts as a Wild. Exactly two Scatters in the base game randomly select one Toad level and turn all lower Toad symbols into that selected level; the win is calculated after the upgrade.

Three, four or five Scatters award 9, 12 or 15 Free Spins. The bonus starts with one automatic upgrade of the smallest Toad; retriggers with 3/4/5 Scatters add 3/4/5 spins and upgrade the lowest remaining Toad level again. Play’n GO states that retriggers are unlimited.
playn-go-fire-toad.editorial: Fire Toad builds its entire mechanic around the evolution of one symbol family: two Scatters change the paytable within the base spin itself, while Free Spins gradually remove weaker Toad forms from the set. This is not Fire Toad 2's Golden Lilypad/Inferno system.

features.title: Base Toad Upgrade
features.description: The Firefly Scatter also acts as a Wild.

features.title: Free Spins
features.description: Exactly two Scatters in the base game randomly select one Toad level and turn all lower Toad symbols into that selected level; the win is calculated after the upgrade.

features.title: Retrigger upgrade
features.description: Three, four or five Scatters award 9, 12 or 15 Free Spins. The bonus starts with one automatic upgrade of the smallest Toad; retriggers with 3/4/5 Scatters add 3/4/5 spins and upgrade the lowest remaining Toad level again. Play’n GO states that retriggers are unlimited.

intro: Hot Slot: Great Book of Magic connects a book bonus with Collect to Infinity and Sticky to Infinity. Three Scatters open 10 free spins, while retained Collectors can increase their number.
An Expanding Bonus Symbol is selected before Free Spins and expands along a reel during the bonus. This is not Deluxe of the older Great Book of Magic: Hot Slot has its own maximum win of 6000x.
wazdan-hot-slot-great-book-of-magic.editorial: Hot Slot's key difference from the regular book is the Sticky to Infinity → Collect to Infinity → additional Free Spins chain, plus separate Buy Feature levels.

features.title: Three Scatters, ten spins
features.description: Three book Scatters anywhere trigger 10 Free Spins; accumulation through a Collector can increase their number.

features.title: Sticky and Collect to Infinity
features.description: Scatters lock until the trigger, while a Collector collects new books and increases the future sequence.

features.title: The book selects an expanding symbol
features.description: The Expanding Bonus Symbol is determined when the bonus starts; Buy Feature includes six levels, including Triple Extreme.

intro: Fire Toad 2 retains Toad Upgrade but develops it separately from the first game: exactly two Scatters in the base game upgrade all weaker Toad symbols to the selected form. A Golden Lilypad can appear on reel 3 and split a Toad standing on it into two symbols when a winning Toad combination forms.

Three or more Scatters trigger Free Spins with a choice between Normal Upgrade Trail and Best Upgrade Trail. The former provides more spins and starts evolution at the bottom level; the latter has fewer spins but begins with only the strongest Toads on the reels. Reel 3 remains covered with active Golden Lilypads throughout Free Spins.
playn-go-fire-toad-2.editorial: Fire Toad 2 does more than repeat the original's upgrade mechanic: Golden Lilypads add symbol splitting, and Free Spins offer a choice of progression pace. Five Inferno Scatters during the bonus open a final 3 Inferno re-spins with locked Toads and subsequent splitting on Golden Lilypads.

features.title: Golden Lilypad
features.description: Fire Toad 2 retains Toad Upgrade but develops it separately from the first game: exactly two Scatters in the base game upgrade all weaker Toad symbols to the selected form.

features.title: Two Free Spins trails
features.description: A Golden Lilypad can appear on reel 3 and split a Toad standing on it into two symbols when a winning Toad combination forms.

features.title: Inferno Re-Spins
features.description: Three or more Scatters trigger Free Spins with a choice between Normal Upgrade Trail and Best Upgrade Trail. The former provides more spins and starts evolution at the bottom level; the latter has fewer spins but begins with only the strongest Toads on the reels. Reel 3 remains covered with active Golden Lilypads throughout Free Spins.

intro: Magic Bombs uses ten lines with fruit and Wilds in the base game, but its main point of interest is Free Spins preparation through Sticky to Infinity and Collect to Infinity.
Sticky Scatters remain until the bonus triggers, while a Collector helps increase the number of free spins. These features are different from a regular Wild multiplier.
wazdan-hot-slot-magic-bombs.editorial: Magic Bombs has a maximum of 6000x and high volatility. Its distinction lies in bonus preparation rather than line count: Collectors and Sticky symbols change entry into Free Spins.

features.title: Sticky to Infinity
features.description: Retains special Scatters until Free Spins trigger and increases bonus-event probability.

features.title: Collect to Infinity
features.description: A Collector locks and collects additional bonus symbols, increasing the number of future Free Spins.

features.title: Wild, Free Spins and Buy Feature
features.description: The Wild substitutes for regular symbols excluding Scatters, while the bonus can be obtained through a natural trigger or a separate purchase.

intro: Firefly Wilds substitute for regular symbols and can carry an x2 or x3 multiplier. If multiple Multiplier Wilds participate in one winning line, their values multiply together.

The Moon Scatter does not trigger the bonus on its own: Frenzy Spins begin when a Firefly Wild lands on the Moon. The round awards 8 Free Spins, and the Wild quality within depends on the triggering Firefly: regular allows x1/x2/x3, an x2 Firefly leaves x2/x3, and an x3 makes all Wilds x3.
playn-go-firefly-frenzy.editorial: Firefly Frenzy ties bonus strength to the particular Wild that lands on the Moon rather than the Scatter count. A Firefly landing on the Moon again retriggers Spins and can upgrade the Wild level if the new Firefly is stronger than the first.

features.title: Multiplier Fireflies
features.description: Firefly Wilds substitute for regular symbols and can carry an x2 or x3 multiplier.

features.title: Moon Trigger
features.description: If multiple Multiplier Wilds participate in one winning line, their values multiply together.

features.title: Frenzy Spins
features.description: The Moon Scatter does not trigger the bonus on its own: Frenzy Spins begin when a Firefly Wild lands on the Moon. The round awards 8 Free Spins, and the Wild quality within depends on the triggering Firefly: regular allows x1/x2/x3, an x2 Firefly leaves x2/x3, and an x3 makes all Wilds x3.

intro: Magic Pearls brings Hot Slot into a twenty-five-position system without traditional lines. Instead of regular winning combinations, the main route leads to Hold the Jackpot.
Buy Feature allows faster access to the bonus under specified conditions, while a Wild on the base grid is listed separately. This game's maximum is 2500x, rather than the book game's 6000x.
wazdan-hot-slot-magic-pearls.editorial: Magic Pearls should not be classified as a ten-line slot simply because of the Hot Slot title: official Game Info shows 25 reels and zero lines.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot on 25 positions
features.description: Prize symbols persist on the bonus grid, while the game's top award reaches 2500x.

features.title: Buy Feature
features.description: A separate purchase allows entry into the bonus without waiting for a natural trigger.

features.title: Wild and adjustable volatility
features.description: The Wild helps the main game, while Volatility Levels allows profile adjustment according to the official feature list.

intro: Forge of Fortunes uses an unusual 3×1 grid. The aim is to collect three gold symbols in succession; reaching the required gold combination triggers Forging Re-Spins and advances the player along a conveyor belt of cash values.

During Forging Re-Spins, a flashing red light acts as an extra life and resets the re-spin counter. A losing spin does not always end the feature: the game can offer another chance but move the position lower on the conveyor belt.
playn-go-forge-of-fortunes.editorial: Forge of Fortunes deliberately avoids a large reel set: the whole mechanic centres on a 3×1 grid and movement along a reward scale. The provider states feature potential up to x2500 the total bet, reached through successive gold hits and Forging Re-Spins.

features.title: Gold Symbols
features.description: Forge of Fortunes uses an unusual 3×1 grid.

intro: Mystery Jackpot Joker looks like a simple three-reel, five-line game, but its central bonus is Mystery Joker Jackpot Game.
Magic Respin helps reach the jackpot mini-game, while the joker-hat Wild and star Scatter operate in the base game. This is not Rubies' Magic Respin with five rubies.
wazdan-hot-slot-mystery-jackpot-joker.editorial: Mystery Jackpot Joker's top stated payout is 1000x. It should not be assigned nine Coin symbols or Free Spins from neighbouring Hot Slot releases.

features.title: Mystery Joker Jackpot Game
features.description: A separate prize game with mystery jackpots; the provider confirms it as the main bonus feature.

features.title: Magic Respin
features.description: Helps lock the required reels and approach entry into Mystery Joker Jackpot.

features.title: Joker Wild and star Scatter
features.description: The Wild substitutes for regular symbols, while the Scatter participates in additional base-game payouts.

intro: Forge of Gems uses a 5×3 grid with a separate Forge Reel above the main grid. Its special symbols can split regular symbols, award Universal Multipliers and create Stacked Wilds; splitting can raise the number of Dynamic Payways to 36,288.

Three or more Scatters trigger the Gem Box. It can award an Instant Prize, varying numbers of Free Spins or a combination of both; during Free Spins, the accumulated multiplier does not reset between spins.
playn-go-forge-of-gems.editorial: Forge of Gems makes the upper Forge Reel a full mechanical layer: it does more than add a Wild, changing symbol structure itself and the number of ways. The Gem Box separately determines whether the award is instant, spin-based or mixed.

features.title: Forge Reel
features.description: Forge of Gems uses a 5×3 grid with a separate Forge Reel above the main grid.

features.title: Dynamic Payways
features.description: Its special symbols can split regular symbols, award Universal Multipliers and create Stacked Wilds; splitting can raise the number of Dynamic Payways to 36,288.
